in_arabic.name: محيي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم محيي مشتق من الفعل حيّ، ويعني الذي يعيد الحياة ويحيي الموتى، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية 39، وله أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام لأنه يرمز إلى قدرة الله على إحياء الموتى في الآخرة.

in_urdu.name: محی
in_urdu.meaning: جو زندگی عطاکرتا ہے، موت سے بچاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام محی عربی زبان کے الفعل حی سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے جو زندگی عطاکرتا ہے، موت سے بچاتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر ہندوستان اور پاکستان میں۔ اسلامی روایت میں اس کا بڑا دینی اور روحانی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहयee
in_hindi.meaning: जो जीवन देता है, मृत्यु से बचाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहयee नाम की उत्पत्ति عربی भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है जो जीवन देता है, मृत्यु से बचाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर बच्चों के नामकरण में चुना जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम अल्लाह की शक्ति और उसकी जीवन देने की क्षमता का प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Muhyee
in_english.meaning: The one who gives life, revives the dead
in_english.long_meaning: The name Muhyee originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-y-y' which means 'to give life'. In Islamic tradition, Muhyee is one of the names of Allah, signifying His power to revive the dead and give life. This name holds significant spiritual and theological importance in Islam and is referenced in the Quran (Quran 3:39). The name Muhyee symbolizes divine power, mercy, and the ability to bring life to those who are lifeless.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muhyee holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it emphasizes the belief in the power and mercy of Allah (God). In Islamic texts and teachings, the concept of giving life is often attributed to Allah alone. Therefore, the name Muhyee can be seen as a reminder of Allah's power and ability to bring life to anything, whether it is a dead heart, a troubled mind, or a desolate land.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muhyee holds great significance for Muslims as it serves as a reminder of the role of Allah in their lives. It serves as a constant reminder that no matter how hopeless a situation may seem, Allah has the power to bring life and healing to it. The name also symbolizes the belief in the power of dua (prayer) and tawakkul (trust in Allah) to bring about positive change. By carrying the name Muhyee, one may be constantly reminded to turn to Allah in times of need and to trust in His mercy and power to bring about healing and transformation.
